description.value:
You can enact a short ritual to haunt prey you've singled out. Once per day during your daily preparations, you can take 10 minutes to target a creature whose name you know (and who is within 100 miles). Upon completion of the ritual, the target immediately knows you are seeking them out and must attempt a @Check[will|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If you have never met the target, it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the save.

Critical Success The target knows of your intent, but is otherwise unaffected. The target becomes temporarily immune to this ritual for 1 week.

Success The target is wracked by a sense of dread at your approach. The next time the target sees you before your next daily preparations, they become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure As success, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} when they see you. They also become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fatigued] by the impending terror for 10 minutes after you perform this ritual.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Drained]{Drained 1} for as long as it is fatigued.
